engine: double machine learning (gradient boosting), within person

method.walk: Double machine learning: gradient boosting learns what the meal (calories, carbs, protein, fat, fiber, sugar, meal type) predicts about the rise and about whether you walked; the effect is fitted on what is left, within person. 5-fold cross-fitting repeated 3 times; person-clustered 95% CI.
method.walkDinner: Double machine learning: gradient boosting learns what the meal (calories, carbs, protein, fat, fiber, sugar) predicts about the rise and about whether you walked; the effect is fitted on what is left, within person. 5-fold cross-fitting repeated 3 times; person-clustered 95% CI.
method.late: Double machine learning: gradient boosting learns what the meal (calories, carbs, protein, fat, fiber, sugar) predicts about the rise and about whether dinner started at 8 pm or later; the effect is fitted on what is left, within person. 5-fold cross-fitting repeated 3 times; person-clustered 95% CI.
method.hour: Double machine learning: gradient boosting learns what the meal (calories, carbs, protein, fat, fiber, sugar) predicts about the rise and about the dinner start time; the effect is fitted on what is left, within person. 5-fold cross-fitting repeated 3 times; person-clustered 95% CI.
method.negctrl: Double machine learning: gradient boosting learns what the meal (calories, carbs, protein, fat, fiber, sugar, meal type) predicts about the pre-meal reading and about whether you walked; the effect is fitted on what is left, within person. 5-fold cross-fitting repeated 3 times; person-clustered 95% CI.

real.note: Same DML as the program, on CGMacros (calories, carbs, protein, fat, fiber; no sugar column).
